Input image 1 is the edit target: a transparent neighborhood asset with SIX complete houses. Input image 2 is ONLY a ground placement guide, not an asset to copy.
Change ONLY the spatial arrangement and uniform size of the existing six houses so their GROUND FOOTPRINT CENTERS match the six red crosses in the guide. Preserve each house design, the warm ivory walls, terracotta roof, dark blue windows, adult editorial 2D linework, oblique camera and upper-left lighting. Do not replace the houses or create new identities.
Keep a 1254x1254 square canvas. Make each individual house uniformly about 80% of its current size; all houses keep the same scale. The red crosses are the center of the physical base/foundation, NOT the center of the roof or the whole illustration. Place H1 (original upper house) at ground center (796,481); H2 (original right house) at (1090,689); H3 (original middle-left house) at (513,646); H4 (original middle-right house) at (787,875); H5 (original lower-left house with a small side extension) at (216,840); H6 (original front/bottom house) at (479,1075). Feet centered within the six purple diamonds. The diamonds indicate the footprint room, not a colored floor to draw.
The houses may project their roofs upward from the ground positions. Keep every house whole and inside the canvas. Maintain natural isometric neighborhood spacing, not a frontal card grid. Deliver ONLY these same SIX houses together as one neighborhood layer. Absolutely no street, paths, ground, opaque plot, grass, garden, tree, fence, extra building, person, vehicle, guide, diamond, cross, text, label, number, symbol or UI. All areas between/outside the houses must have genuine alpha zero. Preserve a clean transparent RGBA cutout with no background, checkerboard, glow or outside shadow. Do not copy any markings from the guide.
